about.title: About DeutschConnect
about.tagline: Your school. Your ideas. Your network.
about.whatText: DeutschConnect is a platform developed by students that lets schools organise joint events, ideas and projects. Students should be able to take the initiative themselves and connect with other schools.
about.originText: The idea came from a group of students at Ernst-Reuter-Schule Ankara. An earlier design prototype for German lessons turned into a platform for cross-school collaboration. Anka Bilim has shown interest as the first partner school.
about.works1: Web prototype for smartphone and desktop
about.works2: Interface in German, Turkish and English
about.works3: Demo with fictional profiles and sample data
about.open3: A real event organised through the platform
about.impactText: No results have been collected yet. After the first pilot, real activities and feedback will be documented here.
about.competition: DeutschConnect is to be submitted to the 10th DIHK competition for German schools abroad, “Schüler bauen weltweit Brücken” (Students build bridges worldwide).

events.title: Manage events
events.subtitle: Create, publish, cancel and complete events.

empty.all: There are no events yet. Create the first one as a draft.

events.draftHint: Draft – only visible to admins; students cannot see this event yet.
events.archivedHint: Archived on {date} (Ankara) – no longer visible to students. All details and sign-ups are kept.
events.final: Completed or cancelled – the status can no longer be changed.
events.timeZoneNote: All times are Ankara time (UTC+3). Published events are cancelled, not deleted, so sign-ups remain traceable.

confirm.publish: Publish “{title}”? All signed-in students will see the event and can sign up. The date must be in the future. A published event cannot become a draft again.
confirm.publishConfirmed: Publish “{title}” directly as confirmed? Students will immediately see the event as “Confirmed” and can sign up. The date must be in the future.
confirm.confirm: Mark “{title}” as confirmed? Students will see that the event will definitely take place.
confirm.cancel: Cancel “{title}”? The event stays visible but is shown as cancelled; new sign-ups are no longer possible. There is no automatic notification – please also inform those who signed up. This step is final.
confirm.complete: Mark “{title}” as completed? This is only possible once the event has started. This step is final.
confirm.delete: Permanently delete the draft “{title}”? This cannot be undone.

events.created: “{title}” was saved as a draft. Publish it once everything is correct.

ideas.title: Moderate ideas
ideas.subtitle: Review, approve or reject submitted ideas.

empty.all: No ideas have been submitted yet.

confirm.approve: Approve “{title}”? The idea will then be visible to all signed-in students and can be supported.
confirm.reject: Reject “{title}”? The idea will then only be visible to the person who submitted it.
confirm.toReview: Move “{title}” to review? The idea stays publicly visible – the schools check whether it can be done.
confirm.toPlanned: Mark “{title}” as planned? This step is final and cannot be undone.
confirm.backToCollecting: Move “{title}” back to “Gathering interest”? The idea stays publicly visible.
confirm.reopen: Reopen “{title}” for review? The idea stays private until you approve it again.
confirm.delete: Permanently delete “{title}”? The idea and all of its support will be removed for good – also for the person who submitted it. This cannot be undone.

ideas.final: Planned – no further moderation steps possible.
